title: Localqw6 guest gui by xxxomer12345678
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)

-- Ana Frame oluştur
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 700)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true -- Sürüklenebilir yapmak için aktif olması gerekir
mainFrame.Draggable = true -- Frame sürüklenebilir hale getirildi
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

-- Başlık ekleyelim
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
title.Text = "Guest GUI"
title.TextSize = 24
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
title.Parent = mainFrame

-- Genel buton oluşturma fonksiyonu
local function createButton(name, positionY, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Text = name
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40) -- Buton genişliği frame'e göre ayarlandı
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, positionY)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    button.TextSize = 18
    button.Parent = mainFrame
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- 1. Guest Heykel
createButton("Guest Heykel", 60, function()
    -- Yanıma heykel ekleme
    local statue = Instance.new("Model", workspace)
    statue.Name = "Guest 666"
    
    -- Heykelin rengini kırmızı yapalım
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Size = Vector3.new(4, 12, 4)
    part.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 10)
    part.Anchored = true
    part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
    part.Parent = statue
    
    -- Heykelin üzerine fire efekti ekleyelim
    local fire = Instance.new("Fire", part)
    fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    
    -- Sunucudaki kişileri heykelime çekme
    for _, plr in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr.Character then
            plr.Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0, 5))  -- Herkesin heykelin yanına gitmesini sağla
        end
    end
end)

-- 2. Guest Gücü 1
createButton("Guest Gücü 1", 110, function()
    -- Envantere tool ekleyelim
    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = "Bucak"
    tool.RequiresHandle = true
    tool.Parent = player.Backpack
    local handle = Instance.new("Part", tool)
    handle.Size = Vector3.new(1, 5, 1)
    handle.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow")
    handle.Anchored = false
    handle.CanCollide = false
    handle.Name = "Handle"

    -- Tool'ü aldığımızda vurma efekti
    tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        local mouse = player:GetMouse()
        local target = mouse.Target
        if target and target.Parent and target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            -- Vurma işlevi
            target.Parent.Humanoid:TakeDamage(10) -- Hedefe 10 hasar ver
        end
    end)
end)

-- 3. Araba
createButton("Araba", 160, function()
    -- Araba ekleyelim
    local car = Instance.new("Model", workspace)
    car.Name = "Araba"
    local body = Instance.new("Part", car)
    body.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 12)
    body.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(10, 0, 0)
    body.Anchored = false
    body.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")

    -- Tekerlekler
    for i = 1, 4 do
        local wheel = Instance.new("Part", car)
        wheel.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
        wheel.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        wheel.Position = body.Position + Vector3.new(i % 2 * 4, -2, (i - 1) * 6)
        wheel.Anchored = false
        wheel.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Black")
    end
    
    -- Sürme işlevi
    local vehicleSeat = Instance.new("VehicleSeat", car)
    vehicleSeat.Position = body.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 3)
    vehicleSeat.Parent = car
    car.PrimaryPart = body
end)

-- 4. Music
createButton("Music", 210, function()
    -- Şarkıyı çalmaya başla
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound", workspace)
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1847661821"
    sound.Volume = 1
    sound:Play()
end)

-- 5. Mute Music
createButton("Mute Music", 260, function()
    -- Müzik durduruluyor
    for _, sound in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if sound:IsA("Sound") then
            sound:Stop()
        end
    end
end)

-- 6. Disco
createButton("Disco", 310, function()
    -- Ekranı renkli yapma (Disco efekti)
    game.Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255))
    -- 1 saniye aralıklarla renk değiştirmeyi başlat
    while true do
        wait(1)
        game.Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255))
    end
end)

-- 7. Guest Mezar Kazma
createButton("Guest Mezar Kazma", 360, function()
    -- Mezar kazma tool'u ekleyelim
    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = "Mezar Kazıcı"
    tool.RequiresHandle = true
    tool.Parent = player.Backpack
    local handle = Instance.new("Part", tool)
    handle.Size = Vector3.new(1, 5, 1)
    handle.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
    handle.Anchored = false
    handle.CanCollide = false
    handle.Name = "Handle"

    -- Mezar ekleyelim
    local grave = Instance.new("Model", workspace)
    grave.Name = "Mezar"
    local gravePart = Instance.new("Part", grave)
    gravePart.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
    gravePart.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 10)
    gravePart.Anchored = true
    gravePart.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark green")

    -- Rasgele birini mezara koyma
    local randomPlayer = game.Players:GetPlayers()[math.random(1, #game.Players:GetPlayers())]
    if randomPlayer.Character then
        randomPlayer.Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(gravePart.CFrame)
    end
end)

-- 8. Guest En İyi Gücü
createButton("Guest En İyi Gücü", 410, function()
    -- Renkli bloklar ekleme ve patlama
    local block = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
    block.Size = Vector3.new(4, 4, 4)
    block.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
    block.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
    block.Anchored = false
    block.Name = "Block"
    
    -- Patlama
    wait(3)
    local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion", workspace)
    explosion.Position = block.Position
    explosion.BlastRadius = 10
    explosion.BlastPressure = 10000
end)

-- 9. Guest Gücü 666
createButton("Guest Gücü 666", 460, function()-- Renkli bloklar dönme ve yanma efekti
    local block = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
    block.Size = Vector3.new(4, 4, 4)
    block.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
    block.Anchored = false
    block.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
    block.Name = "DynamicBlock"
    
    -- Etrafında bloklar dönecek
    local bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro", block)
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(10000, 10000, 10000)
    bodyGyro.CFrame = block.CFrame
    bodyGyro.D = 10

    -- Bloklar dönerken yanma efekti
    local fire = Instance.new("Fire", block)
    fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    
    -- Bloklar yanarak hareket edecek
    while true do
        wait(0.5)
        block.BrickColor = BrickColor.Random() -- Renk değişimi
        fire.Enabled = true
        -- Zıplama ve renk değişim etkisi
        block.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
    end
end)

-- 10. Guest Heykel 666 (Devam)
createButton("Guest Heykel 666", 510, function()
    -- Heykel dikme ve etrafındaki kişileri çekme
    local statue = Instance.new("Model", workspace)
    statue.Name = "Guest 666 Statue"
    
    -- Heykel kısmı
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Size = Vector3.new(6, 20, 6)
    part.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(10, 0, 0)
    part.Anchored = true
    part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
    part.Parent = statue
    
    -- Heykel üzerine fire efekti ekleyelim
    local fire = Instance.new("Fire", part)
    fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    
    -- Sunucudaki kişileri heykelin yanına çekme
    for _, plr in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr.Character then
            plr.Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0, 10))  -- Tüm oyuncuları yanına çekme
        end
    end
end)

-- GUI'yi ekle
screenGui.Parent = player.PlayerGui
